title: From Dusk Till Dawn
tagline: A terrifying evil has been unleashed.
about: Two bank robbers take a preacher's family hostage across the Mexican border to an all-night bar that turns out to be full of vampires.

    Bar snacksBig Kahuna pineapple slidersSeth's burger run back to the motel. Teriyaki beef, grilled pineapple, Swiss cheese.How to make it500g beef mince4 pineapple rings, fresh or tinned60ml teriyaki sauce8 slices of Swiss cheese8 slider buns8 cos lettuce leaves3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseShape the beef into 8 thin patties and season.Grill the pineapple rings until charred and cut each in half.Cook the patties in a hot pan, brushing with teriyaki, and melt a slice of cheese on each.Build in the toasted buns with mayo, lettuce and pineapple.Earl McGraw's no-microwave burritosEarl says microwave food will kill you. Oven-crisped beef and bean burritos.How to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp chipotle chilli powder400g tin refried beans150g cheddar, grated4 large flour tortillas1 tbsp vegetable oil125g sour cream200g tomato salsaBrown the beef with the onion, cumin and chipotle until dark and dry.Spread each tortilla with beans, add the beef and cheese, and roll up tight.Brush with oil and bake seam down at 200°C until crisp.Halve and serve with sour cream and salsa.Totopos and salsa rojaOn the bar until the sun comes up.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.PlatesEl Rey pork carnitas tacosSeth pays Carlos for El Rey. Crisp slow pork with onion and lime.How to make it1.2kg pork shoulder, in large chunks1 orange, juiced4 garlic cloves, smashed1 tsp dried oregano1 tsp ground cumin2 bay leaves12 small corn tortillas1 white onion, finely diced1 bunch coriander, chopped3 limes200g salsa verdePut the pork in a heavy pot with the orange juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, bay leaves, salt and water to just cover.Simmer uncovered until the water is gone and the pork is tender and frying in its own fat.Shred and fry in batches until crisp at the edges.Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, onion, coriander, salsa verde and lime.Aztec temple chicken moleThe bar sits on an Aztec temple. Dark chilli and chocolate sauce over rice.How to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets3 dried ancho chillies, seeded2 dried chipotle chillies, seeded1 brown onion, chopped3 garlic cloves400g tinned tomatoes40g almonds2 tbsp sesame seeds1 tsp ground cinnamon40g dark chocolate, chopped500ml chicken stock300g white riceToast the chillies in a dry pan, then soak them in hot water for 15 minutes.Fry the onion, garlic, almonds and half the sesame, then blend with the drained chillies, tomatoes, cinnamon and stock until smooth.Simmer the sauce until thick and dark, then melt in the chocolate.Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, while the rice cooks.Serve over the rice with the rest of the sesame on top.AftersWooden stake churros with dark chocolateSeth brings down the wooden chandelier. Cinnamon sugar churros and hot chocolate dip.How to make it250ml water60g butter1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for rolling150g plain flour2 eggs2 tsp ground cinnamon1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g dark chocolate, chopped200ml pouring creamBoil the water, butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt, tip in the flour and beat until it leaves the pan.Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs until smooth and glossy.Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180°C and fry until golden.Roll in the cinnamon sugar while hot.Melt the chocolate into the hot cream and serve as a dip.Behind the barChango micheladaThe Titty Twister pours Chango. Mexican lager, lime, hot sauce and a salt rim.How to make it4 x 355ml bottles of Mexican lager3 limes2 tsp hot sauce2 tsp soy sauce2 tbsp chilli salt2 cups ice cubesRim 4 glasses with lime and dip them in chilli salt.Add ice, the juice of half a lime, hot sauce and soy to each and top with the lager.Seth's bottle and a shot glassI'm gonna sit here and I'm gonna finish this bottle.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
